name: Song Recognizer
description:
Recognize the song your computer is playing, from the top bar or quick settings, with SongRec.

Nothing is recorded until you press the button. Then it records a few seconds of your computer's sound (or the microphone) with PipeWire's pw-record and runs the songrec command you installed, which sends a fingerprint of that sound to Shazam's servers and returns the song. Every song found is kept in a history, in the extension's settings. Clicking a song opens its Shazam page or, if you choose, copies its title and artist to the clipboard.

Not affiliated with Shazam or Apple. SongRec is an unofficial client.
